name: 火箭重拳
description: 选择正方向，冲刺最多5格，在首个棋子或障碍前停下。撞到敌人时造成2.5倍伤害。
code: function executeSkill(context) { var source = context.piece; var pos = selectTarget({ type: 'grid', range: 5, filter: 'all' }); if (!pos || pos.needsTargetSelection) return pos; var dx = pos.x - source.x; var dy = pos.y - source.y; if ((dx !== 0 && dy !== 0) || (dx === 0 && dy === 0)) return { success: false, message: '目标必须与末日铁拳在同一行或同一列' }; var direction = { x: dx === 0 ? 0 : (dx > 0 ? 1 : -1), y: dy === 0 ? 0 : (dy > 0 ? 1 : -1) }; var trace = flow.query.tracePath(source, direction, {excludePieceId:source.instanceId,maxDistance:5}); var finalX = trace.lastLandableCell.x; var finalY = trace.lastLandableCell.y; var collision = trace.encounters.find(function(e){return e.type==='piece';}); var collidedPiece = collision && flow.query.piece(collision.pieceId); var hit = collidedPiece && !arePlayersAllied(battle, collidedPiece.ownerPlayerId, source.ownerPlayerId) ? collidedPiece : null; if (!flow.effects.displace([{pieceId:source.instanceId,x:finalX,y:finalY}], 'dash', {}).success) return {success:true,message:'位移被阻挡，本次位移效果取消'}; var message = source.name + '使用火箭重拳冲刺至(' + finalX + ',' + finalY + ')'; if (hit) { var damage = Math.floor(source.attack * context.skill.powerMultiplier); var result = dealDamage(source, hit, damage, 'physical', battle, context.skill.id); message += '，对' + hit.name + '造成' + result.damage + '点物理伤害'; } return { success: true, message: message }; }
previewCode: function calculatePreview(piece, skillDef) { var damage = Math.floor(piece.attack * skillDef.powerMultiplier); return { description: "选择正方向，冲刺最多5格，在首个棋子或障碍前停下。撞到敌人时造成2.5倍伤害。", expectedValues: { damage: damage, range: 5 } }; }
